turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Let us start with one example that I solve completely.
She eats ___ apple. First, I read the next word: "apple". Next, I check its first sound. It is a vowel sound. Last, I pick "an" because of that sound. She eats an apple.
Rule: use "an" before a vowel sound; use "a" before other sounds.
This is right: I have a pen. This is wrong: I have an pen.
Now try one. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
